g.text: The central diamond-like slow branch is absent in the isotropic control. This supports its pseudo-acoustic qSV interpretation;

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526070

g.text: it is not a modal projection of the original heterogeneous wavefield. The isotropic PDE has a zero slow eigenvalue.
